name: comb_connected_of_min_degree_half
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : ∀ v : V, Fintype.card V ≤ 2 * G.degree v + 1) : G.Connected
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : ∀ v : V, Fintype.card V ≤ 2 * G.degree v + 1), G.Connected
informal: A graph on n vertices with every degree ≥ (n-1)/2 is connected — two non-adjacent vertices u ≠ v have neighbourhoods inside V \ {u,v} (n-2 elements) of total size ≥ n-1, so they share a neighbour; hence any two vertices are at distance ≤ 2.
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_3 : DecidableRel G.Adj], (∀ (v : V), Fintype.card V ≤ 2 * G.degree v + 1) → G.Connected
